'''Nick Kolnik''' (forum handle '''bluethrawn''') served as an advocate of the [[Players Committee]] for marketing and tournaments.

He accepted an invitation to become the Marketing &amp; Tournaments Player Advocate in 2004. His responsibilities were promoting tournaments and communicating event information to the playing community, working directly with the Tournaments Advocate.<ref name="newadv2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603214022/http://www.swccgpc.com/News/NewAdvocates.htm New Advocates! Not 1 but 2!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref> In October 2004 [[Michael Carr]] wrote that he would work with Kolnik on Worlds 2005 and its qualifying season.<ref name="carr">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041013013300/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/MikeBio.htm Meet Michael Carr, New Tournaments Advocate!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 13 October 2004)</ref>

Kolnik donated his entire collection to a school-run Star Wars CCG program. The starwarsccg.org About Us page calls him &ldquo;a former Advocate and devoted Star Wars CCG player&rdquo; (spelled &ldquo;Nick Kolnick&rdquo;).<ref name="aboutlive">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/about-us/ About Us], starwarsccg.org (viewed 10 October 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020234816/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/about-us.html Internet Archive].</ref>
